title: Detailed hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sandGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd77a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8a53a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandGrad2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0b64f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc8a26'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='28' y='8' width='44' height='7' rx='3' fill='#c98b3a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='8' width='44' height='3.5' rx='2' fill='#e6b566'/>
  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='28' y='85' width='44' height='7' rx='3' fill='#c98b3a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='88.5' width='44' height='3.5' rx='2' fill='#e6b566'/>

  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M34 15 C34 15 62 40 62 50 C62 60 34 85 34 85 L66 85 C66 85 38 60 38 50 C38 40 66 15 66 15 Z' fill='#a8dcef' opacity='0.45'/>
  <path d='M34 15 L66 15 C66 15 38 40 38 50 C38 60 66 85 66 85 L34 85 C34 85 62 60 62 50 C62 40 34 15 34 15 Z' fill='none' stroke='#7ec6df' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- sand in top bulb -->
  <path d='M40 25 C40 25 50 42 50 50 L50 44 C50 38 44 28 44 25 Z' fill='url(#sandGrad)'/>
  <path d='M40 25 L40 35 C44 42 47 46 50 48 L50 44 C47 42 44 36 44 28 L44 25 Z' fill='url(#sandGrad)'/>
  <path d='M60 25 C60 25 50 42 50 50 L50 44 C50 38 56 28 56 25 Z' fill='url(#sandGrad)'/>
  <path d='M60 25 L60 33 C56 39 53 44 50 47 L50 44 C53 41 56 34 56 28 L56 25 Z' fill='url(#sandGrad)'/>
  <!-- top sand surface -->
  <path d='M41 26 C45 30 48 34 50 36 C52 34 55 30 59 26 Z' fill='#ffd77a'/>

  <!-- falling stream -->
  <rect x='49' y='47' width='2' height='18' fill='#ffcf6b'/>
  <rect x='49' y='47' width='1' height='18' fill='#ffe9a8'/>

  <!-- sand in bottom bulb -->
  <path d='M36 78 C40 70 46 64 50 62 C54 64 60 70 64 78 Z' fill='url(#sandGrad2)'/>
  <path d='M38 78 C41 72 46 66 50 64 C54 66 59 72 62 78 Z' fill='#f7c667'/>
  <!-- little pile peak -->
  <path d='M46 68 L50 62 L54 68 Z' fill='#ffe09a'/>

  <!-- highlights on glass -->
  <path d='M36 18 C36 18 40 30 40 38' stroke='#dff3fa' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 62 C64 62 60 70 60 76' stroke='#dff3fa' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
